hero.role: Senior Full-Stack Engineer · Web, Mobile & Cloud
hero.description: Lead engineer of HiveCare, a HIPAA-ready healthcare SaaS live on the web and the App Store. I take products from the data model to production: Python backends with FastAPI and Django, apps in React, Next.js and Flutter, and the Google Cloud infrastructure they run on.

about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I'm Jose, a senior full-stack engineer with 5 years of experience. I like owning a product from the data model to production: the API in Python, the database in PostgreSQL, the web and mobile apps, and the infrastructure, security and billing work that real products need.
about.paragraph2: Right now I'm the lead engineer of HiveCare, a messaging and calling platform for home-care agencies built by a three-person team. I wrote the backend and the Flutter apps, run the Google Cloud infrastructure, integrated Stripe and turned HIPAA requirements into working controls. Before that, at Datazucar, I took a lab GIS for Cuba's sugar industry to a deployed, field-piloted system, a project I presented at Informática 2024.
about.paragraph3: I also build tools for AI agents (MCP servers in Vizion and SketchSlides) and write about Django, FastAPI and shipping Python on Medium. I'm open to remote senior full-stack and backend roles.

hivecare.title: HiveCare
hivecare.description: HIPAA-ready messaging and calling platform for home-care agencies, live on the web and the App Store.
hivecare.problem: Home-health agencies coordinate staff who are always on the move, often through ordinary chat apps that expose patient information and leave no audit trail. They needed one secure place for messages, calls and care coordination, built for protected health information from day one.
approach: A FastAPI + SQLAlchemy backend with WebSockets for real-time messaging, and one Flutter codebase for the web, iOS and Android apps.
Voice and group calls with WebRTC: peer-to-peer when possible, a LiveKit media server for groups and a self-hosted TURN server so calls work behind strict networks.

Google Cloud with separate staging and production projects: Cloud Run, Cloud SQL with high availability and point-in-time recovery, Secret Manager, and CI/CD through Workload Identity Federation, with no long-lived keys.

HIPAA turned into code: patient data encrypted with Cloud KMS, a tamper-evident audit log, least-privilege database roles, per-agency isolation, PHI export and account deletion, and versioned legal agreements.
Self-service agency sign-up with Stripe: agreements, payment, subscriptions, plan changes and refunds.
Automated releases to the App Store and Google Play, plus internal security audits before each rollout.
hivecare.outcome: In production. The iOS app has been on the App Store since October 2026 and the Android app is in review on Google Play. About 1,100 commits and 235 test files so far.
features: One-to-one and group messaging, broadcast channels and voice messages
Clients, visits and check-in/check-out for staff
Role-based access for administrators, staff and clients
Encrypted PHI, audit log and device verification
hivecare.role: Lead engineer in a three-person team: backend, apps, cloud infrastructure, payments and compliance. My teammates led UX/UI design, the website and QA.

vizion.title: Vizion — Report Designer
vizion.description: SaaS for designing pixel-perfect paginated reports on top of your own SQL databases.
vizion.problem: Small and mid-sized companies still produce invoices, statements and certificates with Excel templates or old reporting tools. Dashboard products don't solve it: these documents need exact layouts, groups, totals and pagination, built from live company data.
approach: A browser-based designer with report bands (headers, detail, groups, footers), tables, charts, barcodes and QR codes, rendered to PDF on the server.
Multi-tenant from the start: each organization connects its own databases, and connection strings are encrypted and never sent back to the browser.
A visual query builder and a SQL editor that run against the customer's database through the server.
An MCP server with OAuth and dynamic client registration, so AI agents like Claude can design and generate reports against a real database.
Unit, integration, end-to-end (Playwright) and visual regression tests.
features: Drag-and-drop canvas with snapping, rulers and layers
Templates for invoices, certificates, credentials and more

sugarcane-gis.title: GIS for the Sugarcane Industry
sugarcane-gis.description: Took a university lab GIS for Cuba's sugar industry to a deployed, field-piloted system with real-time harvester tracking.
sugarcane-gis.problem: The GIS started as a university lab prototype: a map that showed GeoServer layers and nothing else. The data that made it useful lived elsewhere: field details in the CPlus databases of several companies, and harvester positions in a precision-agriculture service with no WebSockets and no GeoJSON.
approach: Linked the map's field layers with the CPlus databases of several companies through PostgreSQL Foreign Data Wrapper, exposed as GeoServer views, so the map shows soil types, cane varieties and harvest data per field.
Polled the precision-agriculture REST API on a schedule, converted its data to GeoJSON and pushed positions to the browser over WebSockets.
Matched harvester routes against fields and checked cutting speed, raising real-time alerts when a harvester cut a field too fast or too slow, and kept a daily log of every route.

Deployed the system with Nginx, Gunicorn, GeoServer on Tomcat and PostgreSQL/PostGIS (until then it had only run in the lab) and load-tested the harvester pipeline: 4,000 harvesters processed within the 30-second refresh window, against a fleet of 1,266.
sugarcane-gis.outcome: A three-month field pilot with live harvesters: routes visible in real time, a daily route history and crop data on the map. Presented at Agrociencias 2023, at the Informática 2024 international convention in Havana (paper with two co-authors) and at the Varadero 2024 business fair, and selected for GEIC's INNOVA 2024 innovation contest.
features: Live harvester tracking and route history
Field data from several company databases on one map

django-generator.title: Django Generator
django-generator.description: Automatically generate Django applications from YAML config.
django-generator.problem: Starting a Django app means writing the same models, admin and boilerplate over and over, and it's easy to get relationships wrong along the way.
approach: A declarative YAML schema that describes apps, models and their relationships.
Multi-phase validation that catches errors before any code is generated.
A browser editor built with Next.js and Monaco Editor to write and validate the YAML.
Customizable templates for the generated code.
django-generator.longDescription: This package allows you to automatically generate Django applications and models from a YAML configuration file, streamlining your development process by defining your data structure declaratively.
django-generator.challenges: Parsing complex YAML structures and generating valid Django code required careful validation and error handling. I implemented a multi-phase validation system to ensure generated code would work correctly and a custom IDE browser using Monaco Editor.

django-erd-designer.title: Django ERD Designer
django-erd-designer.description: Visual ERD designer for Django applications.
django-erd-designer.longDescription: A web-based tool that allows developers to design Entity-Relationship Diagrams (ERD) visually and automatically generate complete Django applications from them. The tool connects with django-generator to transform the visual diagram into fully functional Django models, migrations, and admin configurations. It supports all Django model field types, relationships, and common model patterns.
django-erd-designer.challenges: The main challenge was creating an intuitive interface for complex model relationships while ensuring the generated code follows Django best practices. I implemented a custom drag-and-drop interface with real-time validation and used a two-way conversion system between the visual diagram and the underlying data structure.
features: Interactive ERD diagram builder with drag-and-drop interface
Support for all Django field types and relationships
Real-time code preview as you design
Export to full Django application via django-generator
Import existing Django models to visualize

terminal-playground.title: Terminal Playground
terminal-playground.longDescription: Learn core CLI commands without local setup via guided lessons. This project was designed to help beginners get comfortable with terminal commands in a safe, interactive environment.
terminal-playground.challenges: Creating a realistic terminal emulation in the browser required careful handling of user input and command parsing. I solved this by implementing a custom command interpreter with React hooks for state management.
features: Responsive design that works on all devices

coinit-platform-landing-page.longDescription: Designed for collectors to showcase, trade, and connect over rare items. The landing page highlights key features of the platform with interactive demos and clear call-to-action sections to drive conversions.
coinit-platform-landing-page.challenges: Creating performant animations that work across all devices while maintaining SEO best practices required careful optimization. I implemented lazy loading and progressive enhancement strategies.

personal-tracker.longDescription: A personal organization tool that lets you chat with your data using LLM technology. Track habits, expenses, notes and more in a unified interface with powerful search and analysis capabilities.

email-handler.title: Email Handler
email-handler.description: Platform for managing email lists and newsletters.
email-handler.longDescription: A complete solution for entrepreneurs to manage their email marketing campaigns. Includes list segmentation, analytics, and template management with a focus on ease of use and deliverability.
email-handler.challenges: Ensuring high deliverability required implementing proper email validation, bounce handling, and engagement tracking. I integrated with multiple ESP APIs to provide the best results.
